## Quarto

```{r}

library(MASS)
library(Hmisc)
library(rms)
library(boot)
library(glmnet)

d <- MASS::birthwt
d$smoke <- factor(d$smoke, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("No", "Yes"))
d$race <- factor(d$race, levels = c(1, 2, 3), labels = c("White", "Black", "Other"))
stopifnot(nrow(d) == 189, !anyNA(d[, c("bwt", "age", "lwt", "smoke", "race")]))
Hmisc::describe(d[, c("bwt", "age", "lwt")])
```

```{r}

d <- MASS::birthwt
d$smoke <- factor(d$smoke, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("No", "Yes"))
d$race <- factor(d$race, levels = c(1, 2, 3), labels = c("White", "Black", "Other"))
stopifnot(nrow(d) == 189, !anyNA(d[, c("bwt", "age", "lwt", "smoke", "race")]))
Hmisc::describe(d[, c("bwt", "age", "lwt")])
```

```{r}

set.seed(2026)
train_id <- sample(seq_len(nrow(d)), size = floor(0.70 * nrow(d)))
train <- d[train_id, ]
test <- d[-train_id, ]
```

```{r}
linear_fit <- lm(bwt ~ age + lwt + smoke, data = train)
summary(linear_fit)
```

```{r}
quadratic_fit <- lm(bwt ~ age + lwt + I(lwt^2) + smoke, data = train)
summary(quadratic_fit)
```

```{r}
# 3 degrees of freedom; training knots reused by predict().
spline_fit <- lm(bwt ~ age + splines::ns(lwt, df = 3) + smoke, data = train)
summary(spline_fit)
```

```{r}
new_people <- data.frame(
  age = rep(median(train$age), 100),
  lwt = seq(min(train$lwt), max(train$lwt), length.out = 100),
  smoke = factor(rep("No", 100), levels = levels(train$smoke))
)
plot(train$lwt, train$bwt, pch = 16, cex = 0.5,
     xlab = "Maternal weight (lb)", ylab = "Birth weight (g)")
lines(new_people$lwt, predict(linear_fit, newdata = new_people), col = "black", lwd = 2)
lines(new_people$lwt, predict(quadratic_fit, newdata = new_people), col = "blue", lwd = 2)
lines(new_people$lwt, predict(spline_fit, newdata = new_people), col = "red", lwd = 2)
legend("topleft", c("Linear", "Quadratic", "Natural spline"),
       col = c("black", "blue", "red"), lty = 1, bty = "n")
```

```{r}
cv_linear_fit <- glm(bwt ~ age + lwt + smoke, data = train, family = gaussian())
cv_quadratic_fit <- glm(bwt ~ age + lwt + I(lwt^2) + smoke,
                        data = train, family = gaussian())
```

```{r}
set.seed(2026)
cv_linear <- boot::cv.glm(train, cv_linear_fit, K = 5)$delta[1]
set.seed(2026)
cv_quadratic <- boot::cv.glm(train, cv_quadratic_fit, K = 5)$delta[1]
c(Linear_MSE = cv_linear, Quadratic_MSE = cv_quadratic)


x_train <- model.matrix(bwt ~ age + lwt + smoke, data = train)[, -1, drop = FALSE]
x_test <- model.matrix(bwt ~ age + lwt + smoke, data = test)[, -1, drop = FALSE]
y_train <- train$bwt



```

```{r}



set.seed(2026)
ridge_cv <- glmnet::cv.glmnet(x_train, y_train, family = "gaussian",
                             alpha = 0, nfolds = 5, type.measure = "mse")
set.seed(2026)
lasso_cv <- glmnet::cv.glmnet(x_train, y_train, family = "gaussian",
                             alpha = 1, nfolds = 5, type.measure = "mse")
par(mfrow = c(1, 2))
plot(ridge_cv, main = "Ridge: 5-fold CV")
plot(lasso_cv, main = "Lasso: 5-fold CV")
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
coef(ridge_cv, s = "lambda.min")
coef(lasso_cv, s = "lambda.min")

# 9. FINAL TEST-SET EVALUATION (ISLR 5)
# Compare models on the same untouched observations.
pred_linear <- predict(linear_fit, newdata = test)
pred_quadratic <- predict(quadratic_fit, newdata = test)
pred_spline <- predict(spline_fit, newdata = test)
pred_ridge <- as.numeric(predict(ridge_cv, newx = x_test, s = "lambda.min"))
pred_lasso <- as.numeric(predict(lasso_cv, newx = x_test, s = "lambda.min"))

mse <- c(
  Linear = mean((test$bwt - pred_linear)^2),
  Quadratic = mean((test$bwt - pred_quadratic)^2),
  Spline = mean((test$bwt - pred_spline)^2),
  Ridge = mean((test$bwt - pred_ridge)^2),
  Lasso = mean((test$bwt - pred_lasso)^2)
)
round(data.frame(MSE = mse, RMSE = sqrt(mse)), 2)
# Do not select and then report the minimum test MSE as unbiased performance.

# 10. RMS: SPLINE EFFECTS AND ANOVA (ESL 5)
# Refit on training data for diagnostics; use x/y for bootstrap validation.
dd <- rms::datadist(train)
options(datadist = "dd")
rms_spline <- rms::ols(bwt ~ age + rcs(lwt, 4) + smoke,
                       data = train, x = TRUE, y = TRUE)
print(rms_spline)
anova(rms_spline)  # Nonlinear row tests departure from linearity
plot(rms::Predict(rms_spline, lwt),
     xlab = "Maternal weight (lb)", ylab = "Predicted birth weight (g)")

# 11. RESIDUAL DIAGNOSTICS (OLS)
par(mfrow = c(2, 2))
plot(linear_fit, which = c(1, 2, 3, 5))
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))

# 12. BOOTSTRAP MODEL VALIDATION (ISLR 5)
set.seed(2026)
rms::validate(rms_spline, method = "boot", B = 200)

# 13. BOOTSTRAP CI FOR MEAN BIRTH WEIGHT (ISLR 5)
set.seed(2026)
Hmisc::smean.cl.boot(train$bwt, B = 1000, conf.int = 0.95)

```
